title: Testimonial Components
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a Website Visitor, I want to see authentic testimonials from other customers So that I can trust the company and make informed decisions about their services

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

To build trust and credibility with potential customers by showcasing real experiences from satisfied clients through an engaging and accessible testimonial display system.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* Users are more likely to engage with visual content (photos/videos) than text alone
* Website visitors want to see proof from real customers before making decisions
* A diverse range of testimonials from different industries/roles will be more effective
* Content administrators will need to regularly update testimonials
* Users may access the testimonials from various devices and connection speeds
* Not all customers will provide all optional content elements (like company logos)

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:clipboard:</custom> Global Requirements

* The testimonial component should be able to display multiple slides that can be navigated
* The component should also be able to be used as a single quote
* Navigation controls should be visible and easy to use
* The component should be responsive and work well on all device sizes
* Images and videos should be optimized for web performance
* It is possible to place the component in a single row or in a multi-column layout

    * If it is used in a multi-column layout, it dynamically adjusts sizes etc.
    

### Technical Requirements:

* Responsive design implementation
* Proper content management system integration for easy updates

### Definition of Done:

* Component is fully responsive and tested across different devices
* All navigation controls are working properly
* Content management system allows easy addition/editing of testimonials
* Performance tests show optimal loading times for images and videos
* Accessibility requirements are met
* Code has been reviewed and approved

---

## CMS Testimonial Persona Quote

This component is particularly eye-catching and can only be used if you also have profile pictures, as the design is based on this visual element. If you do not have any pictures, you should use the Quote Card.

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7389-38139&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7389-38139&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4) 

#### **Requirements:**

* Each slide contains:

    * A profile picture 
    * A testimonial quote text
    * The person's first and last name
    * Their current position (optional)
    * Their company name
    * Their Company Logo (optional)
    
* Slide transitions are animated to match the [mobile dummy ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7383%3A37011&show-proto-sidebar=1)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-4">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7383%3A37011&show-proto-sidebar=1) and [desktop dummy ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7389%3A37651&show-proto-sidebar=1)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-5">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6904-152633&p=f&viewport=603%2C292%2C0.1&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-0&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=7389%3A37651&show-proto-sidebar=1)
* Quotes can have light, dark oder bright background with the according text and ui element colors
* You can choose between [three styles for the profile picture](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7368-32242&t=WmdxQg1pxxyigx8X-4):

    * Speech Bubble
    * Round
    * Square
    * The Speech Bubble Style has a different corner radius on mobile and desktop 
    

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=27b56394-4974-4a34-834c-81046b9dfea7&&collection=&height=495&occurrenceKey=null&width=326&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
* Height of each slide adjusts to the height of the highest slide

    * There are no max. characters, but we recommend approx. 200 characters.
    
* Logos sizes:

    * square or portrait logos have a max height of 50px
    * rectangle logos have a max width of 130px and should have a height of 30px
    * logo safe area is 130x50 px
    
* If one slide has no logo, but the others have a logo, the layout remains default
* If all slides have no logo, the layout changes to "no logos":

## CMS Testimonial Quote Card

The Quote Card is used to display simple quotes or customer reviews and works best in a slider, but also in content or as a grid.

[Design examples](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7763-32584&m=dev)

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7763-32585&m=dev](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7763-32585&m=dev)###  **Quote Card Requirements:**

* User can choose Card Style:

    * default
    * on dark background
    * on bright background
    * outline
    * haptic
    
* Cards contain:

    * Logo (optional)
    * [Star Rating](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7409-40884&m=dev) (optional)
    
        * Default displayed variant depends on chosen card style
        * User can change style of the Star Rating
        
    * Quote
    * Author Information:
    
        * Profile Picture (optional)
        * Name
        * Up to 2 Additional Information (optional)
        
    
* Cards can have left oder center aligned content
* User can change card background color
* Logos sizes:

    * square or portrait logos have a max height of 50px
    * rectangle logos have a max width of 130px and should have a height of 30px
    * logo safe area is 130x50 px
    

### Quote Card Slider

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7763-27474&m=dev](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7763-27474&m=dev)* simple animation
* no max. cards limit
* for lg breakpoint and above: fixed card with:

    ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=1325c5a6-2336-40af-ba77-77949801744b&&collection=&height=255&occurrenceKey=null&width=640&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
* user can choose card style for the slider
* user can change card background color
* user can choose star rating variant
* user can choose navigation style (bullets or numbers)
* Height of each card adjusts to the height of the highest card

    * There are no max. characters, but we recommend approx. 200 characters.
